decisions.reason: The shared-footer decision does not change the landing page's existing visual design; its same-message approval Event comes from item 1 rather than the footer decision.

The footer and dark-theme decision does not change responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance; the same-message responsive Event resolves a separate numbered item.
The decision concerns website-page headers, footers, and theme, not the independently scoped console shell or its footer component.
The shared website footer decision does not change the implementation stack or design-handoff objective.
